name: Broken-Wing Put Butterfly
summary: A put butterfly with the lower wing skipped further out so the trade opens for a credit; no risk if the underlying rallies, with the only real loss below the far lower strike. The most widely used BWB variant on index ETFs.

legs.strike_rule: inner long: put delta -0.30 to -0.40 (just OTM below spot)
body: inner long strike - narrow width W1 (W1 = 1.0-1.5% of spot), body delta -0.20 to -0.25
outer long: body - wide width W2 where W2 = 2 x W1; outer delta -0.08 to -0.12

typical_dte: 17-45 DTE; the canonical version is entered at 21 DTE
when_to_use: IV rank > 35 and steep put skew (which makes the outer long cheap relative to the body), an index ETF or large-cap in an uptrend, and no earnings inside the expiry. Put skew is why this version is structurally easier to open for a credit than the call BWB.
max_profit: W1 x 100 + net credit, at the body strike
max_loss: (W2 - W1) x 100 - net credit, below the outer long strike. Defined.
breakevens: single lower breakeven between the body and the outer long; no upper breakeven when opened for a credit - a rally scratches to the credit

greeks.delta: slightly positive at entry (+3 to +10 per unit)
greeks.gamma: negative between the outer long and the body
greeks.theta: positive when spot is above the body

entry_rules: Open for a net CREDIT; reject any fill that would be a debit larger than 3% of W1.
W2 = 2 x W1 exactly (skip one strike interval below the body).
Inner long delta -0.30 to -0.40; body -0.20 to -0.25; outer long -0.08 to -0.12.
Target credit of 12-18% of W1 when using the mechanical 21 DTE variant.
Max loss ((W2 - W1) x 100 - credit) <= 1.5% of equity per unit.
IV rank >= 35; no earnings inside the expiry.
All three strikes: OI >= 500, prior-day volume >= 100, per-leg spread <= max($0.05, 10% of mid).
Single multi-leg order at the natural mid, accept mid - $0.03.
management_rules: Mechanical variant: on fill, immediately rest a GTC order to close at 2% of W1; it typically fills with 7-8 DTE left.
Discretionary variant: close at 25-50% of max profit - trigger when mark >= 0.30 x (W1 x 100 + credit).
Time rule: close at 7 DTE unconditionally, and never carry into the final week's gamma.
Breach rule: close if the short body put delta exceeds 0.40 in absolute value, or if spot closes below the inner long strike.
Never roll the outer long up to harvest credit; that widens the tail.
exit_rules: ASSIGNMENT GUARD: the 2 short body puts are the exposure. Flatten by 15:45 ET on expiration day, unconditionally.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: close immediately if the short body puts are ITM with extrinsic < $0.10.
TAIL GUARD: close the entire structure if spot trades below the outer long strike; the position is at max loss there and only assignment risk remains.
Hard time exit at 7 DTE; the 21 DTE variant exists specifically so the position never sees expiration-week gamma.
assignment_risk: Two short body puts; assignment means buying 200 shares per unit at the body strike - roughly $115k of SPY on a $50k account. The inner long put offsets 100 of those shares economically; the outer long is far away. Short puts do not carry dividend-driven early assignment, but deep-ITM short puts with no extrinsic are routinely assigned. The $0.10-extrinsic rule and the 7 DTE exit keep the system clear of this.
buying_power: ((W2 - W1) x 100) - net credit, per unit.
liquidity_needs: Moderate-to-high; SPY/QQQ/IWM and liquid large caps. The far outer long needs OI >= 500 or the exit slips badly.
common_mistakes: Treating the credit as the max loss; skipping two or three strikes to boost the credit and quietly tripling the tail; running it through earnings; holding into expiration week where the body gamma is worst; entering when put skew is flat, which makes a credit structurally impossible without a dangerous W2.
zero_dte_notes: Works 0DTE on SPY/QQQ as a credit-collecting bullish-lean structure: a rally or a flat tape scratches or wins, only a fast selloff through the outer strike loses. Use locally computed deltas (Alpaca returns none at 0DTE - solve IV from the option mid with T in seconds to 16:00 ET). Enter after 10:00 ET, stop out on a print below the outer long, flatten by 15:45 ET.
family: three-leg-structures (butterflies, broken-wing butterflies, lizards, three-strike ratio spreads, ladders/tree spreads, christmas trees, and three-leg stock+option hybrids)
